decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent using creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, while also applying pressure with evasive creatures such as Blade of the Oni. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for aggressive plays with a mix of black and red sources. Overall, the deck strives to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, focusing on dealing damage quickly and efficiently. The deck includes powerful aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Emberheart Challenger, along with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike to deal direct damage to the opponent or remove blockers. Cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Monstrous Rage provide additional ways to pump up creatures and push through damage. The deck also includes some utility lands like Mutavault and Ramunap Ruins to provide additional damage sources.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy low-cost artifacts and turn them into powerful threats using cards like Ensoul Artifact and Cryptic Coat. By combining aggressive creatures like Regal Bunnicorn and Spyglass Siren with disruptive spells like Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and versatile offense. Utilizing a mix of artifact creatures and artifact-enhancing spells, this deck seeks to establish early board presence and maintain pressure on opponents throughout the game.

This deck focuses on controlling the battlefield by utilizing graveyard interaction and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to slowly grind down the opponent's resources while maintaining card advantage through cards like Cling to Dust and Scrabbling Claws. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Ketramose, the New Dawn provide additional threats to pressure the opponent. The mana base is designed to support the deck's control elements while providing a consistent mana base for casting spells.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board. The deck also utilizes evasive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Faerie Miscreant to apply pressure and close out games quickly. By combining disruptive elements with powerful creatures, this Dimir Aggro deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents to secure a fast victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful board presence by sacrificing creatures with effects that benefit from being sacrificed, such as Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also utilizes cards like Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to generate incremental advantage and chip away at the opponent's life total. With a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm opponents with cheap, efficient creatures and direct damage spells. Using aggressive creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Monastery Swiftspear, along with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike, the goal is to apply constant pressure and end the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also utilizes cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Monstrous Rage to enhance its creatures and push through additional damage. With a low mana curve and high aggression, this deck aims to win the game swiftly and decisively.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. Utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Burst Lightning, and Lightning Strike, combined with creatures like Heartfire Hero and Emberheart Challenger, the deck aims to deal damage to the opponent's life total as fast as possible. With support from lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins, as well as the versatile Manifold Key, this aggro deck is designed to put pressure on the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries to activate the Arclight Phoenix's ability, allowing for repeated attacks and pressure on the opponent. The deck also focuses on card advantage and tempo plays with cards like Treasure Cruise and Brazen Borrower, while providing additional sources of damage with cards like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse. The inclusion of cards like Picklock Prankster and Artist's Talent helps to further support the aggressive playstyle of the deck. Additionally, the deck includes some versatility and disruption with counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal spells like Spikefield Hazard.

The core idea of this deck is to overwhelm opponents with fast and efficient creature cards along with direct damage spells. The focus is on dealing quick and consistent damage to the opponent's life total while maintaining board presence with aggressive creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Kumano Faces Kakkazan. The deck also includes versatile cards like Bonecrusher Giant for removal and burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike to finish off opponents. Additionally, lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional damage sources.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells and filling the graveyard to bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times in a game. The deck includes cheap cantrips and removal spells to both dig for the Phoenix and keep the opponent's board clear. It also includes card advantage spells like Treasure Cruise to help refill the hand. The key strategy is to be aggressive with spells and creatures early on, pressuring the opponent and overwhelming them with repeated Phoenix attacks while maintaining control of the game with disruption spells and card advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck includes a mix of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, along with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand. The creatures in the deck are powerful threats that can quickly end the game if left unanswered. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan, with plenty of black sources to cast the deck's powerful spells.

This control deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw cards and gain card advantage. With a diverse mana base and cards like Bring to Light, Leyline Binding, and Vanishing Verse, the deck aims to control the board while ramping up towards powerful threats like Elesh Norn, Nahiri, and Valki. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value with enter the battlefield effects. Overall, the deck looks to out value the opponent and control the game through a combination of removal, card draw, and powerful threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play aggressive creatures and direct damage spells to damage the opponent as quickly as possible. It utilizes a mix of creature cards with haste and direct burn spells to put pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they can set up their own strategy. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and burn spells, ultimately seeking to win the game through aggressive combat and direct damage.

This deck focuses on quickly casting aggressive creatures and spells to deal damage to the opponent quickly and efficiently. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's strategy and powerful creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dreadhorde Arcanist, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Leyline of Resonance and Monstrous Rage further amplifies the aggro strategy by increasing the damage output of your creatures. The mana base is optimized to ensure a smooth curve of spells and creatures throughout the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through countering spells, removing threats, and card advantage. It utilizes a large number of lands and cards that provide additional resources to outvalue the opponent. The key strategy is to play defensively and disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up your own win condition. The addition of Yorion as a companion allows for a flexible sideboard option and provides more value through blinking permanents. This deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a victory through attrition and resource management.
